verdict.rationale: An llms.txt is served (HTTP 200) on the Mozilla.ai docs host that also hosts the llamafile docs, so an agent has an entry point. However, the visible snippet only lists any-llm entries and does not show llamafile pages, and the llamafile.md markdown variant returns a 'Page Not Found' body. Missing for 10: confirmed llamafile-specific entries in llms.txt, working markdown/agent-oriented versions of the llamafile pages, independent corroboration of agent use.
